short_release_notes:
Apollo Passive Receive 1.0.0 Build 95 for Linux ARM64 keeps KA9Q evidence capture on the measured owned RF channel. The generic spectral carrier estimate remains evidence and no longer becomes an unowned capture request. It retains Build 94 periodic physical receiver-provenance renewal.

Managed update only; no KA9Q, SDRplay or RTL runtime changes. No local canonical repeater matching.
